title: Photo Lock: Hide Videos, Pics
summary: Hide & lock videos, photos, pictures; App lock, Calculator, Gallery, Downloader
description:
【Lock Box】A hidden space disguised as calculator! Provides photo and video hidden encryption, privacy browser, video downloader, app lock, message lock, photo lock, gallery lock

💡【What can I lock for you?】
· Lock photos and videos
· Lock private apps, prevent others from viewing (eg: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, Email, Browser, etc.)
· Lock system apps, avoid privacy breaches and malware attacks (eg: phone calls, text messages, contacts, photo albums)
· Lock private Message, Sensitive message notifications
· Prevent others from modifying mobile phone settings, paying for consumption, installing and uninstalling mobile applications

🌄【Photo Vault】
· Hide Photo & Hide Video
Encrypted private files cannot be found by other apps
· Files Safe
Password is required to enter the Photo Box, you can import and export files any time
· Files Explorer
You can freely adjust and optimize pictures, create folders and sort, classify storage

🌏【Privacy Browser】
Here you can browse private websites to your heart’s content without worrying about being discovered.
· Provide collection and browsing history, automatic backup and recovery
· Includes ultimate access speed and performance

🚀【Video Downloader】
· You can quickly download photos and videos from the websites, and encrypt them directly
· Video player, that supports a large number of HD video formats

🚫 【App Lock】
· Locker: lock videos, lock pictures, lock photos, lock gallery, applock, lock apps
· Adopt the most secure encryption method, which is not easy to be cracked
· Can be locked and unlocked very smoothly, supports fingerprint, graphic and digital passwords
· Monitors intruders in real time and records photos of those trying to crack passwords

🔐【Calculator Lock】
· Hide app, disguise the app icon and interface as a calculator
· Enter "digital password" + "=" in the calculator interface to unlock

📌【Lockbox Notice】
· All files are still stored in your phone and will not be lost or destroyed
· If you forget password, you can change password through email verification
· In calculator mode, after entering the wrong 4-digit password three times, you will be prompted to retrieve the password
